en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 7. It was narrated to me by Ali b. Ahmad b. Abdillah from his father from his grandfather Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah from his father from Uthman b. Isa from Ali b. Salim from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
The punishment of that person will be the severest who released his semen in a womb, which was prohibited for him.”
